scope: seven vessel concepts and one sourced accessory panel

items.title: Forever in the Game
items.description: Purple and gold basketball, coiled black snake and a wood-look pedestal.
items.note: Single-head snake correction applied. Inscription remains editable; no finished sample verified.

items.title: MVP - Baseball Glove
items.description: Weathered glove, baseball details and a wood-look tiered base.
items.note: Rear support baseball is occluded in this front view. Placeholder dates omitted.

items.title: Mom’s Tough Love
items.description: A kitchen diorama with mother and child, framed by a wood-look lid and base.
items.note: Speech bubble and plaque lettering intentionally omitted for editorial review. Original closure and STL pairing unresolved.

items.title: Timeless Elegance
items.description: A black vessel with gold floral ornament, fine bands and a domed lid.
items.note: Ornamental rendering is an interpretation; confirm exact relief against CAD. Midnight Blossom file pairing remains provisional.

items.title: Legacy Lives On
items.description: Blue suede-look texture, sculpted white lacing and a rectangular pedestal.
items.note: Original blue design preserved; inscription omitted. Dimensions await engineering reconciliation.

items.title: Every Step Legacy
items.description: An asymmetric black and bronze vessel with tread, stitching and a sweeping divider.
items.note: Original athletic direction, separate from DOC NOTES trail concept. Generated texture is illustrative; CAD is being developed separately.

items.title: Infinite Loop
items.description: A restrained black cylinder wrapped by a sculptural ribbon.
items.note: Flat lid revised. A mathematically correct Möbius half-twist is still not established by this image; resolve in future geometry.

items.title: Every Step - companion concepts
items.description: Miniature keepsake, infinity-path pendant and rectangular dog-tag keychain.
items.note: Rose-gold tone is a distinct accessory proposal, not the original bronze finish. No verified scale, cavities, closures or working QR. Bracelets and heart necklace remain outside this pilot.
